$comment: Source of truth for GitHub milestones. Apply with scripts/sync-milestones.sh. Keep in sync with docs/ROADMAP.md.

milestones.title: M0 Foundations (v0.0.x)
milestones.description: Rust workspace, architecture ADRs, plugin SDK, capability model, semantic core, CLI skeleton, fixtures, policies.

milestones.title: M1 State MVP (v0.1.0)
milestones.description: First public release: local ods state plan/run/explain on dbt with SQLite state and exact-selection dbt executor; code- and data-aware (dbt source freshness, Delta table versions, staleness policies).

milestones.title: M2 Databricks & data-aware State (v0.2.0)
milestones.description: Unity Catalog metadata, full Delta change providers, remaining freshness policies, REUSE/DEFER/CLONE, PostgreSQL store with locking, secrets.

milestones.title: M3 ERD & Usage (v0.3.0)
milestones.description: Provider-neutral ERD with dbt provider and renderers; usage intelligence with Unity Catalog provider.

milestones.title: M4 ODS CI (v0.4.0)
milestones.description: SQL parser, column lineage, change-impact engine, selective CI, PR reports, data diff.

milestones.title: M5 LSP & VS Code (v0.5.0)
milestones.description: Clean-room LSP and VS Code extension.

milestones.title: M6 ODS Agent (v0.6.0)
milestones.description: Agent runtime, BYOK LLM providers, policy/approval, patch engine, validation, first skills.

milestones.title: M7 Platform: Mesh & Server
milestones.description: Unscheduled. Mesh, server mode, REST API, RBAC, audit, language bindings, docs site, multi-repo.

milestones.title: M8 Integrations & Operations
milestones.description: Unscheduled. OpenMetadata/Elementary/MetricFlow, cost, observability, alerting, governance, dev environments.

milestones.title: M9 ods-synthetic
milestones.description: Unscheduled. Synthetic data module (depends on M1 + M3).

duplicates.$comment: duplicate -> canonical. Closed with state_reason=duplicate by the sync script when --close-duplicates is passed.
